questions.question: Please provide a source for the claim that the Pythagoreans drew the pentagram in the sand when greeting one another. The linked paper-knot source does not substantiate this historical claim.

questions.question: Please document the source and rights basis for all three illustrations. They appear to reproduce photographs and a diagram from “A Regular Pentagon: a Knot in a Paper Strip” after cropping and colour processing. Provide a confirmed basis for reuse, or replace them with original illustrations.
